text:
jordan_sales: Quick sync — Acme wants a short POC but their security team insists all data for the POC must stay within EU regions only. Can we confirm: hosted API can be restricted to EU routing? Also need a ballpark pricing delta vs default global routing.

maria_se: Short answer: yes, we can route to EU-only for the POC. Two options: (1) Hosted with region-restriction in the control plane, (2) Dedicated EU pool (reserved) for stronger isolation.

jordan_sales: What does "region-restriction in the control plane" mean in practice? Do tokens or KV cache ever leave EU?

maria_se: With hosted routing policy set to EU-only, inference traffic will be served from EU subprocessors only. KV cache and transient data used for inference stay in-region. Persistent logs & metrics can be configured to be EU-only too. We rely on EU cloud providers + our EU partners (see subproc list).

chris_security: To add: for Hosted EU-only we use AWS eu-west-1 and GCP europe-west3 depending on capacity. Subprocessors: AWS EMEA, GCP EMEA, and DataSafe GmbH (managed logging). Full list: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/subprocessors (send official link to customer).

jordan_sales: Customer asked about fallback behavior — if EU capacity hits a limit, will we route to US as fallback? They said "no way" for this POC.

maria_se: We can set a strict routing policy with no fallback. Example config we give customers for the POC:

```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: strict
  route_by: region
  allowed_regions:
    - eu-west-1
    - europe-central-1
  fallback: none
```

maria_se: With that config, requests that can't be served in allowed regions fail fast with 429/451, not routed elsewhere. That meets "no cross-border" demand.

chris_security: Also note: for EU-only hosted, we can enable customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) so keys are in the customer's EU KMS. Audit logs can be retained in EU S3 buckets.

kelly_legal: For contract asks: we'll provide a DPA + SCCs. If they require EU-only subprocessors enumerated in contract we can append the EU subprocessor list. If they require on-prem or air-gapped, recommend Redwood Private (on-prem bundle) — that's a different procurement track.

jordan_sales: Pricing — what's the ballpark uplift for a POC if they want strict EU-only hosted vs default hosted?

maria_se: Ballpark (for POC scale): Hosted EU-only (no SLA change, region pinning) = ~+10% on per-token unit due to capacity premiums. Dedicated EU pool (reserved GPUs for them) = setup + monthly reserve; POC minimal booking ~4 GPUs, price depends on model family (we can give exact after we know model).

jordan_sales: Can you give me a short line I can feed into the customer email: one-liner on what hosted EU-only guarantees and cost delta

maria_se: "Hosted EU-only: inference and transient logs are processed in EU subprocessor regions only; no cross-border fallback if strict routing enabled. Expect ~10% per-token premium for POC-level reservations; Dedicated EU pools available for stronger tenancy/isolation (separate quote)."

chris_security: Also include: "Customer-managed KMS, EU audit log retention, and contractual subprocessor commitments available."

ops_bot: [deploy-bot] New doc created: Compliance → EU Subprocessors list (updated 2026-02-18) — https://redwood.example.com/compliance/subprocessors

jordan_sales: Great. Action items: (1) Maria to draft routing config + short SOW snippet for the POC (2) Kelly to prepare DPA + subprocessor addendum (3) Chris to send KMS/retention tech note.

maria_se: I'll draft the config + SOW section today and attach example network flow diagram.

kelly_legal: I'll prepare the DPA + list and add a note about SCCs. ETA EOD tomorrow.

chris_security: I'll put together a 1-page tech note on KMS & logs retention and the exact subprocessors used per region.

jordan_sales: Perfect — I'll loop in Acme POC (sarah.acme) with the brief and propose Wed for kickoff. :thumbsup:

maria_se: Heads-up: if they want model weights to never leave EU for model onboarding, we should route them to Dedicated or Private — hosted inference still pulls open model artifacts from S3 during onboarding but we can mirror into EU-only storage for the POC.

jordan_sales: Noted. I'll ask them whether they need model onboarding isolation or just inference traffic.

kelly_legal: One more — if they push for a subprocessor-level SLA, that becomes an enterprise negotiation (likely requires Dedicated + legal review).

jordan_sales: Good call. Thanks everyone. I'll update the deal doc and ping again when I have Acme's response. :eyes:
